quests.title: The Pilgrims' Tales
quests.summary: Hear Chaucer's pilgrims tell their tales, beat them, and report to the Host of the Chequer of Hope.

steps.text: Hear the Knight's tale on the Pilgrims' Way.
Hear Robin the Miller by the hop farm oast.
Hear the Wife of Bath in the cathedral precincts.
Hear the Pardoner by the Westgate.
Hear the Nun's Priest down by the Stour.

quests.reward: A free supper: Gypsy Tarts, Kentish Hops and standing in England.

quests.title: Becket's Relics
quests.summary: Walk the story of Thomas Becket for the archivist's exhibition.

steps.text: Stand at the Martyrdom and hear the verger's story.
Meet Brother Edward in the crypt.
Collect a pilgrim badge from the Westgate Towers museum.

quests.title: The Secret Tunnels
quests.summary: Help reopen Admiral Ramsay's operations room in the tunnels under Dover Castle.

steps.text: Get past the Wren signaller in the tunnels.
Put Ramsay's map back up in the operations room.
Take the news to the Harbourmaster at the ferry terminal.

quests.title: Mods and Rockers
quests.summary: Get the mods and the rockers to ride together in the anniversary rally on Madeira Drive.

steps.text: Beat the Ace Face on the end of the Palace Pier.
Beat Ton-Up Terry on Madeira Drive.
Fetch a peace offering from the Rock Shop in the Lanes.

quests.reward: The Mod Target Badge charm and Brighton Rock.

quests.title: The Knucker Pie
quests.summary: Bake a peace pie for the knucker of Lyminster, and meet what comes up for it.

steps.text: Get flour from the miller at Jack and Jill.
Find a pie dish at the antiques shop in Brighton's Lanes.
Take them to the churchwarden at Lyminster.
Come back to the knucker hole at night.

quests.reward: The Knucker itself, if you can catch it.
